entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Fetan fet, aw Atty Jamet, mate aw tepan min emanji de pop ne kobe. Kabajati oum sembe ku fetanfet nyemi momay, de sambaye yourley yamakaye, kabajatiyoum waff de fu bajafoley famakafu. Bajut Atty Jamet ake a wujumi aw, aranbay nawu de bu gall aw akum fange.
